children.name: q3-review.md
children.content:
---
title: Q3 Platform Review
version: 4.2
team: Platform
theme: zinc
---
^ ${team} · Q3 2026
# Shipping faster with fewer incidents
A review of reliability, velocity and what ships in v${version}.
---
# Where we landed
:::stats style=boxed
- 99.98% | Uptime | +0.04
- 38 | Releases | +12
- 4.1m | p95 latency (ms) | −18%
:::
Note: Pause on uptime — this is the first quarter above four nines.
---
^ Architecture
# Request path, end to end
:::flow style=pipeline
- globe | Edge | 42 PoPs
- shield-check | Auth | JWT + mTLS
- stack | API | Rust / Axum
- database | Postgres | primary + 2 replicas
:::
> [!TIP] Replicas now serve 70% of reads.
---
# What we focused on
:::cards style=grid cols=3
- lightning | Cold starts | Snapshotted runtimes cut boot to 80ms
- git-branch | Preview envs | One per PR, torn down on merge
- bug | Flaky tests | Quarantine bot removed 212 flakes
:::
---
# The config change that did it
```ts edge.config.ts {3,4}
export default defineConfig({
  region: "auto",
  snapshot: true,
  warmPool: 8,
  timeout: 30_000,
})
```
|||
### Why it matters
- Boot time down 6×
- No code changes for teams
- [x] Rolled out to 100%
---
# Roadmap
:::timeline style=h
- Jul | Snapshots GA
- Aug | Preview envs
- Sep | Multi-region writes
- Oct | Edge KV?
:::
---
> Reliability is a feature. Nobody notices it until it's gone.
— SRE handbook

title: Launch Keynote
product: Relay

^ Introducing
# ${product}
Sync your slides to Git. Present from anywhere.
---
# Three reasons teams switch
:::cards style=accent
- git-diff | Reviewable | Every deck change is a pull request
- code | Developer-first | Markdown, variables, code blocks
- paint-brush | Themeable | One file, any brand
:::
---
# Install in ten seconds
:::terminal ~/work
$ npm i -g @relay/cli
added 42 packages in 3s
$ relay init my-talk
✓ Created my-talk/slides.md
$ relay dev
▸ Preview on http://localhost:4000
:::

---
title: Developer features tour
clicks: true
transition: slide
logo: ACME
---
<!-- layout: center -->
^ Tour
# Slides that **speak developer**
Inline `code`, ==highlights==, ~~old ideas~~ and icons :rocket: work in any text.
---
# Walk through code, one click at a time
```ts edge.config.ts {2|3-4|all}
export default defineConfig({
  region: "auto",
  snapshot: true,
  warmPool: 8,
})
```
Note: Press → to move the highlight. Each group is one click.
---
# Magic move — before
```ts handler.ts magic
export async function handler(req) {
  return new Response("ok")
}
```
---
# Magic move — after
```ts handler.ts magic
export async function handler(req) {
  const user = await auth(req)
  if (!user) return new Response("401", { status: 401 })
  return new Response("ok")
}
```
Note: Only the new lines animate in when presenting.
---
# Code straight from the repo
<<< @/src/exec.rs#L3-7 {2|3}
> [!TIP] Edit src/exec.rs and this slide updates — no copy-paste drift.
---
# Reveal step by step
:::cards style=accent
- lightning | **Fast** | Hot reload in `< 50ms`
- git-branch | *Git-native* | Every change is a [PR](#)
- lock | Secure | SSO, audit log :shield-check:
:::

title: Zero-cost async
event: RustConf 2026
---
^ ${event}
# Zero-cost async in practice
---
# The executor loop
```rust src/exec.rs {2}
loop {
    let task = queue.pop().await;
    task.poll(&mut cx);
}
```
> [!WARNING] Never block inside poll().
---
# Layers
:::flow style=stack
- cpu | Hardware | io_uring / epoll
- gear | Reactor | mio
- arrows-clockwise | Executor | tokio
- app-window | Your code | async fn
:::
